policy.stablecoins: A perp is excluded only when the token itself is a stablecoin. Governance tokens of stablecoin issuers (ENA, SKY, USUAL, and similar) stay in. Failed pegs that were issued as stablecoins (USTC) stay out. Price near $1 is not enough on its own, and a ticker that merely contains STABLE is not enough.
policy.k_prefix: A ticker matching k + Uppercase (kPEPE, kBONK) is Hyperliquid's 1000-unit contract on the underlying token. The chain is the underlying token's chain. KAS is not a k-prefix.
policy.native_vs_hosted: asset_role native means the coin is the chain's gas or staking asset. hosted means it was issued on that chain (ERC-20, SPL, jetton, BRC-20, HIP-1) while another asset pays gas. A bridged representation on a second chain does not move the mapping when a home chain is documented (lock-and-release home, gas token, or a single CoinGecko asset_platform_id).
policy.unmapped: If the home chain is unknown, or two chains are co-equal official issuances, the coin is status unmapped. sync never fills that in from a name or a market-cap guess.
policy.prices: USD conversions use Hyperliquid allMids only. USDC, the HL quote asset, is 1 when a chain's gas token is USDC and allMids has no USDC row.
